notes:
Context: Answersmith is a mid-size SaaS vendor that runs a user-facing knowledge base and an AI-first support assistant. They have ~1.2M total raw docs; deduping/chunking to ~200k embeddings is realistic for initial rollout. Primary pain: latency at scale and cost per query under heavy QPS (customer expects sustained spikes to 800-1200 QPS).

Requirements summary:
- Workload: high-QPS doc-search + reranking pipeline. Embeddings store + lightweight ANN for recall, followed by a learned reranker for precision.
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile end-to-end query latency < 150ms (target), P99 < 300ms for read-only routes. Must include rerank step.
- Throughput: sustained 800 QPS, peak 1200 QPS. Batch-friendly but front-door latency sensitive.
- Index size: ~200k chunks initial; plan to grow to 600k over 12 months.
- Cost sensitivity: target blended cost per served query < $0.015; wants cost model transparency and Optimize recommendations.
- Model preferences: open/quantized embedding model for recall; stronger dense reranker (smaller encoder-decoder) for rerank. Wants fallback path to faster cheap model on load.
- Routing/fallback: need automated fallback to smaller reranker or cached responses during throttling.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO (SAML), audit logs, EU data residency. KMS integration desired.

POC notes & results so far:
- Ingest: team tested chunking strategy (250 token chunks) -> 200k vectors.
- ANN: tested HNSW on their current provider; recall OK but recall+rerank improves NDCG substantially.
- Rerank POC (2-week): initial model improved top-5 precision by +18% vs embeddings-only; cost/latency tradeoff obvious: reranker adds ~50-80ms median on our infra without optimizations.
- Streaming vs synchronous: prefer synchronous call for support widget, but streaming could be used for long-form answers.

Quotes from stakeholders:
- "We need consistent sub-150ms for the support widget — anything slower and CSAT drops." — Head of Product (Lina).
- "If we can shave cost by 30% and keep the hit rate we have, that's a green light." — Finance lead.

Open technical asks for Redwood team:
- Provide tuned batching knobs and kernel/profile suggestions for their embedding+ranger pipeline.
- Help size dedicated v. hosted capacity for sustained 1k QPS (they are evaluation-hosted-first; open to dedicated later).
- Confirm EU residency and SOC2 controls mapping; provide KMS/HSM integration path.

Next steps (short):
- Finish 2-week rerank POC (by 2026-03-08): collect P95/P99, NDCG, cost per query at 1k QPS emulation. (owner: Diego)
- Security sync w/ legal (Jordan) — supply SAML metadata and security-faq doc.
- Pricing review with finance (Nina) — confirm estimated ARR band and seat/ingest assumptions.

Blockers: legal needs explicit data residency SLA language; IdP team must provide SAML metadata; internal procurement review scheduled for 03/22.

CRM shorthand: POC healthy, leaning hosted_api + Optimize; reuse cached prefixes for top-funnels; track reranker latency budgets closely.
